orders: Resting 12-lead ECG (to assess for WPW, long QT, Brugada pattern, AV block, or other conduction/rhythm abnormalities)
Transthoracic echocardiogram (to exclude structural heart disease)
24-48 hour ambulatory Holter monitor (to screen for silent arrhythmias)
Signal-averaged ECG (to assess for late potentials suggestive of arrhythmogenic substrate)
Tilt-table test (to evaluate for neurocardiogenic/reflex syncope if any history emerges)
Exercise stress ECG (to assess for exercise-induced arrhythmias or QT changes)
Invasive electrophysiology study (only if non-invasive testing reveals a substrate)
